# Project Architecture Skill

1. Read `AGENTS.md`, package.json, app routes and existing architecture docs.
2. Map routes, components, data flow, map integration, styling and deployment assumptions.
3. Identify constraints and technical risks before proposing changes.
4. Prefer incremental changes compatible with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4.
5. Document trade-offs, migration steps and acceptance criteria.
6. Validate with existing checks and update architecture docs.
Do not add infrastructure or paid services without explicit owner approval.
